input.summary:
Yaba Market Store, Household shelf: 3 of 5 planogram slots correct (Sunlight Detergent 900g, Omo Detergent 1kg, Dettol Soap 110g). Two slots were empty: Lux Soap 80g (0/3) and Close Up Toothpaste 140g (0/3); compliance 60%, no unknown products, no telemetry.

Inventory check shows both stocked-out SKUs still have backroom stock above their reorder point of 6: Lux Soap 8 units, Close Up Toothpaste 9 units. So this is a shelf-refill problem, not a supply problem — no reorders were created. A manager was notified by WhatsApp to put the 8 Lux and 9 Close Up units onto the shelf (Lux will be ~1 unit short of the 9-unit target) and to flag it if backroom stock is actually lower than recorded, in which case we will order full cases of 12.

No technician dispatched — no equipment fault and no telemetry.

Escalating because the audit confidence was 0.49 (auditor note: low_conf): the two "out" readings should be confirmed by eye and the shelf re-photographed before any further action.
